```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
source("tracks/first-draft-may2026/code/common_first_draft.R")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DBI)
  library(duckdb)
})

# ---- Toggles ----------------------------------------------------------------
save_tables <- FALSE  # set TRUE to write .tex files to tables_dir

# ---- Sample window ----------------------------------------------------------
yr_start <- 2012L
yr_end   <- 2024L
min_yrs  <- 3L  # minimum years a bank must appear in window to enter cross-section

ffiec_duckdb_path <- "C:/empirical-data-construction/call-reports-FFIEC/call-reports-ffiec.duckdb"
```

```{r load-master}
# Source: tracks/first-draft-may2026/data/master_bank_zip_year_<DATE>_part*.rds
# Built by: tracks/first-draft-may2026/code/sample-construction/04_build_master_dataset.R
# Contents: bank-zip-year panel; n_branches_bzt, dep_b_zip, bank_assets, state_fips
master_parts <- Sys.glob(file.path(data_dir, "master_bank_zip_year_*_part*.rds"))
dates        <- regmatches(master_parts, regexpr("\\d{8}", master_parts))
latest_date  <- max(dates)
master_parts <- sort(master_parts[dates == latest_date])
dt <- rbindlist(lapply(master_parts, readRDS))
dt[, RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]

setorder(dt, RSSDID, zip5, yr)
dt[, n_branches_lag1 := shift(n_branches_bzt, 1L), by = .(RSSDID, zip5)]
dt[, opening := as.integer(n_branches_bzt > n_branches_lag1)]
```

```{r bank-year-openings}
# Bank-year: total openings, total branches, # active zips, deposits.
by_dt <- dt[yr >= yr_start & yr <= yr_end,
            .(tot_openings   = sum(opening,                    na.rm = TRUE),
              tot_branches   = sum(n_branches_bzt,             na.rm = TRUE),
              n_zips_active  = sum(n_branches_bzt > 0L,        na.rm = TRUE),
              tot_deposits   = sum(dep_b_zip,                  na.rm = TRUE),
              bank_assets    = first(bank_assets)),
            by = .(RSSDID, yr)]

by_dt[, size_bucket := assign_bucket(bank_assets)]
```

```{r bank-level-openings}
# Collapse to one row per bank.  Bank stays in one bucket = mode of size_bucket
# across the years the bank is present in [yr_start, yr_end].
mode_bucket <- function(b) {
  b <- b[!is.na(b)]
  if (!length(b)) return(NA_character_)
  tt <- table(b)
  names(tt)[which.max(tt)]
}

bank_lvl <- by_dt[, .(
  tot_openings_b      = sum(tot_openings, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_n_branches_b   = mean(tot_branches, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_deposits_b_bn  = mean(tot_deposits, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e9,
  mean_assets_b_bn    = mean(bank_assets, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e9,
  n_yrs_obs           = .N,
  size_bucket         = mode_bucket(size_bucket)
), by = RSSDID]

states_b <- dt[yr >= yr_start & yr <= yr_end & n_branches_bzt > 0L,
               .(n_states_b = uniqueN(state_fips)), by = RSSDID]
bank_lvl <- merge(bank_lvl, states_b, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
bank_lvl[is.na(n_states_b), n_states_b := 0L]

# Branch HHI across zips (bank's own branch concentration), averaged over years.
zip_hhi <- dt[yr >= yr_start & yr <= yr_end & n_branches_bzt > 0L,
              .(br = sum(n_branches_bzt, na.rm = TRUE)),
              by = .(RSSDID, yr, zip5)]
zip_hhi[, share := br / sum(br), by = .(RSSDID, yr)]
hhi_yr <- zip_hhi[, .(hhi = sum(share^2, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(RSSDID, yr)]
hhi_b  <- hhi_yr[, .(branch_hhi_b = mean(hhi, na.rm = TRUE)), by = RSSDID]

bank_lvl <- merge(bank_lvl, hhi_b, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)

# Apply bucket filter + minimum years.
bank_lvl <- bank_lvl[!is.na(size_bucket) & n_yrs_obs >= min_yrs]

bank_lvl[, open_rate_b := tot_openings_b / pmax(mean_n_branches_b, 1)]
cat("Banks per bucket:\n"); print(bank_lvl[, .N, by = size_bucket])
```

```{r call-reports}
# Pull Q4 bank-year balance-sheet + income-statement aggregates from FFIEC.
# Restrict to bank-RSSDIDs that survived the bank_lvl filter to keep the pull
# small.  The DuckDB SOD/master uses RSSDID as VARCHAR; bs_panel/is_panel
# use id_rssd (BIGINT) and idrssd (VARCHAR) interchangeably -- join on idrssd.
keep_ids <- unique(bank_lvl$RSSDID)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ffiec_duckdb_path, read_only = TRUE)

bs_sql <- sprintf("
  SELECT idrssd, activity_year AS yr,
         assets, qtr_avg_assets, deposits, transaction_dep,
         td_small, td_mid, td_large, brokered_dep,
         ln_tot, ln_re, ln_ci, ln_cons,
         securities, equity
  FROM bs_panel
  WHERE activity_quarter = 4
    AND activity_year BETWEEN %d AND %d
    AND assets > 0
", yr_start, yr_end)
bs <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, bs_sql))

is_sql <- sprintf("
  SELECT idrssd, activity_year AS yr,
         ytdint_inc, ytdint_exp, ytdint_inc_net,
         ytdnonint_inc, ytdnonint_exp,
         ytdnetinc
  FROM is_panel
  WHERE activity_quarter = 4
    AND activity_year BETWEEN %d AND %d
", yr_start, yr_end)
is_ <- setDT(dbGetQuery(con, is_sql))

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

cr <- merge(bs, is_, by = c("idrssd", "yr"), all.x = TRUE)
setnames(cr, "idrssd", "RSSDID")
cr[, RSSDID := as.character(RSSDID)]
cr <- cr[RSSDID %in% keep_ids]
```

```{r bank-year-ratios}
# Compute ratios at bank-year.  Then collapse to bank-level by mean (avoids
# ratio-of-averages distortion).
cr[, denom_assets := pmax(assets, 1)]
cr[, denom_qavg   := pmax(qtr_avg_assets, assets, 1)]
cr[, denom_dep    := pmax(deposits, 1)]
cr[, denom_loans  := pmax(ln_tot,   1)]

cr[, revenue        := ytdint_inc_net + ytdnonint_inc]
cr[, time_dep_total := td_small + td_mid + td_large]

cr[, roa                := ytdnetinc      / denom_qavg]
cr[, nim                := ytdint_inc_net / denom_qavg]
cr[, eff_ratio          := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdnonint_exp / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, nonint_exp_assets  := ytdnonint_exp / denom_assets]
cr[, int_exp_assets     := ytdint_exp    / denom_assets]
cr[, nonint_inc_revenue := ifelse(revenue > 0, ytdnonint_inc / revenue, NA_real_)]
cr[, loans_assets       := ln_tot     / denom_assets]
cr[, sec_assets         := securities / denom_assets]
cr[, ln_re_share        := ln_re      / denom_loans]
cr[, ln_ci_share        := ln_ci      / denom_loans]
cr[, ln_cons_share      := ln_cons    / denom_loans]
cr[, dep_assets         := deposits   / denom_assets]
cr[, trans_dep_share    := transaction_dep / denom_dep]
cr[, time_dep_share     := time_dep_total  / denom_dep]
cr[, brokered_dep_share := brokered_dep    / denom_dep]
cr[, equity_assets      := equity / denom_assets]

# Asset CAGR: from each bank's first to last year in the window.
cr_growth <- cr[order(RSSDID, yr),
                .(asset_first = first(assets[!is.na(assets) & assets > 0]),
                  asset_last  = last(assets[!is.na(assets) & assets > 0]),
                  yr_first    = first(yr[!is.na(assets) & assets > 0]),
                  yr_last     = last(yr[!is.na(assets) & assets > 0])),
                by = RSSDID]
cr_growth[, asset_cagr := ifelse(yr_last > yr_first & asset_first > 0,
                                 (asset_last / asset_first)^(1 / (yr_last - yr_first)) - 1,
                                 NA_real_)]

ratio_cols <- c("roa", "nim", "eff_ratio", "nonint_exp_assets", "int_exp_assets",
                "nonint_inc_revenue", "loans_assets", "sec_assets",
                "ln_re_share", "ln_ci_share", "ln_cons_share",
                "dep_assets", "trans_dep_share", "time_dep_share",
                "brokered_dep_share", "equity_assets")

cr_b <- cr[, lapply(.SD, function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
           by = RSSDID, .SDcols = ratio_cols]
cr_b <- merge(cr_b, cr_growth[, .(RSSDID, asset_cagr)], by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r merge}
panel <- merge(bank_lvl, cr_b, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r helpers}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a) || !nzchar(a)) b else a

# Winsorize within bucket (1/99) on each characteristic for the comparison.
winsor_in_place <- function(d, vars, p = c(0.01, 0.99)) {
  for (v in vars) {
    x <- d[[v]]
    if (!is.numeric(x)) next
    set(d, j = v, value = winsor(x, p = p))
  }
  d
}

# Build one panel: per characteristic, mean for low/high opener + Welch t-test.
# Returns a data.table ready for emit_panel().
build_panel <- function(d, vars) {
  med <- median(d$open_rate_b, na.rm = TRUE)
  d[, high_opener := as.integer(open_rate_b >= med)]

  rows <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    x_low  <- d[high_opener == 0L, get(v)]; x_low  <- x_low[is.finite(x_low)]
    x_high <- d[high_opener == 1L, get(v)]; x_high <- x_high[is.finite(x_high)]
    if (length(x_low) < 2 || length(x_high) < 2) {
      return(data.table(
        Variable = label_lookup[v] %||% v,
        Low      = "",
        High     = "",
        Diff     = "",
        t        = "",
        N_low    = format(length(x_low),  big.mark = ","),
        N_high   = format(length(x_high), big.mark = ",")
      ))
    }
    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(x_high, x_low), error = function(e) NULL)
    diff <- mean(x_high) - mean(x_low)
    sig  <- if (!is.null(tt)) {
      if (tt$p.value < 0.01) "***"
      else if (tt$p.value < 0.05) "**"
      else if (tt$p.value < 0.10) "*"
      else ""
    } else ""

    data.table(
      Variable = label_lookup[v] %||% v,
      Low      = sprintf("%.3f", mean(x_low)),
      High     = sprintf("%.3f", mean(x_high)),
      Diff     = sprintf("%.3f%s", diff, sig),
      t        = if (!is.null(tt)) sprintf("%.2f", tt$statistic) else "",
      N_low    = format(length(x_low),  big.mark = ","),
      N_high   = format(length(x_high), big.mark = ",")
    )
  })
  rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

emit_panel <- function(stats_dt, file_stem, panel_label = NULL) {
  out_md <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".md"))
  md <- knitr::kable(stats_dt, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE,
                     align = "lrrrrrr")
  writeLines(as.character(md), out_md)
  cat("Wrote:", out_md, "\n")

  if (isTRUE(save_tables)) {
    header <- "\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrrr}\n\\toprule\n"
    col_names <- paste(c("Variable", "Low", "High", "Diff", "$t$",
                         "$N_{\\text{low}}$", "$N_{\\text{high}}$"),
                       collapse = " & ")
    body_lines <- apply(stats_dt, 1L, function(r) {
      paste(c(r[["Variable"]], r[["Low"]], r[["High"]], r[["Diff"]],
              r[["t"]],        r[["N_low"]], r[["N_high"]]),
            collapse = " & ")
    })
    body <- paste(paste0(body_lines, " \\\\"), collapse = "\n")
    tex <- paste0(header,
                  col_names, " \\\\\n\\midrule\n",
                  body, "\n",
                  "\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n")
    out_tex <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".tex"))
    writeLines(tex, out_tex)
    cat("Wrote:", out_tex, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r per-bucket}
# Variables to display in the comparison.  Order: profitability/margin -> cost
# -> asset comp -> funding -> capital -> scale/network/growth.
display_vars <- c(
  "roa", "nim", "nonint_inc_revenue",
  "eff_ratio", "nonint_exp_assets", "int_exp_assets",
  "loans_assets", "sec_assets",
  "ln_re_share", "ln_ci_share", "ln_cons_share",
  "dep_assets", "trans_dep_share", "time_dep_share", "brokered_dep_share",
  "equity_assets",
  "mean_assets_b_bn", "mean_n_branches_b", "n_states_b", "branch_hhi_b",
  "asset_cagr",
  "tot_openings_b", "open_rate_b"
)

# Winsorize each characteristic within bucket.
winsor_vars <- setdiff(display_vars, c("n_states_b", "tot_openings_b"))

panel_big <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "ge_100bn"])
panel_mid <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "10_100bn"])
panel_sml <- copy(panel[size_bucket == "1_10bn"])

panel_big <- winsor_in_place(panel_big, winsor_vars)
panel_mid <- winsor_in_place(panel_mid, winsor_vars)
panel_sml <- winsor_in_place(panel_sml, winsor_vars)

stats_big <- build_panel(panel_big, display_vars)
stats_mid <- build_panel(panel_mid, display_vars)
stats_sml <- build_panel(panel_sml, display_vars)

emit_panel(stats_big, "tab_cross_section_openers_big")
emit_panel(stats_mid, "tab_cross_section_openers_mid")
emit_panel(stats_sml, "tab_cross_section_openers_sml")
```
